Maddie (Design): Quick design review — trace panel control ordering & a11y/copy nits. Mock attached: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (see right rail actions). Sam (Product): Nice. One thought: Export is visually prominent but product usage data says export is rare. Feels like the visual weight should match frequency. Ryan (EngRuntime): From runtime side we also see accidental exports on narrow screens when the Copy button is tiny next to Export. Mobile hit rate for export spikes. Suggest reordering: Copy → Open in Logs → Export (or move Export into a kebab menu). Bernie (A11y): A11y issues to fix: screen readers announce actions in the DOM order, not visual order. Right now Export is read first. Need clear aria-labels (e.g., aria-label="Export trace as JSON"), and a live region message when copy completes: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". Also ensure focus order matches reading order. Jules (UX): Copy text tweak: change button text from "Copy" to "Copy correlation ID" and tooltip "Copies request correlation ID to clipboard" — small change but reduces confusion. Also reduce primary styling on Export (no filled primary color). Maddie (Design): Proposed visual order: [Copy correlation ID] [Open in Logs] [Export]. Draft markup idea below so a11y folks can review: ```html
``` Ryan (EngRuntime): That markup is fine. Suggest grouping export formats under a dropdown to avoid accidental taps: Export ▾ (JSON, HAR, Zip). We can lazily generate JSON to save work unless user expands. Also check keyboard tab order follows that sequence. Sam (Product): Confirming product priority: main actions we expect most users to take are Copy correlation ID and Open in Logs. Export is SRE/Debugger-focused. So putting Export in a secondary dropdown makes sense. Maddie (Design): I'll update the figma to reflect the dropdown + new labels and drop primary treatment from Export. Will also add a small 1-line helper: "Use Export for offline analysis (JSON)" under the dropdown. Bernie (A11y): Additional checklist for the change: 1) aria-expanded on dropdown; 2) aria-controls references export menu; 3) live region for copy success; 4) visible focus ring (2px, WCAG contrast). I'll run a quick screenreader pass once the figma update is posted. a11y-bot: a11y-checker: automated scan queued for https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE — will run accessibility lint in ~4h and report obvious contrast/label issues. Jules (UX): Small copy nit — replace "correlation id" with sentence case everywhere: "Correlation ID". Consistency helps in small UI surfaces. Maddie (Design): Thanks — I'll push changes and post updated link. Planning a short pairing session with Bernie + Ryan tomorrow to validate keyboard nav and export dropdown behavior. Sam (Product): SGTM. Can we also add telemetry event for export click so we can validate frequency after the change? Ryan (EngRuntime): Yep, will add event trace.action.export and trace.action.copy_id. Maddie (Design): Closing loop — I'll post the updated mock and the pairing time. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
